# Fixtures / Échantillons

Retrieved 2026-11-15. Source: City of Toronto, Open Government Licence – Toronto.

Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.

- `toronto-traffic-signal.page.json`: Traffic Signal, https://open.toronto.ca/dataset/traffic-signals-tabular/ (real sampled CKAN response; four records).
- `toronto-pedestrian-crossover.page.json`: Pedestrian Crossover, https://open.toronto.ca/dataset/traffic-signals-tabular/ (real sampled CKAN response; two records).
- `toronto-pops-points.page.json`: POPS - points, https://open.toronto.ca/dataset/privately-owned-publicly-available-spaces/ (real sampled CKAN response; two records).
- `demo-park-facilities.page.json`: demonstration-only, fictional facilities, not source data; licence-gate and AMENITIES tests.
- `demo-pops-polygons.page.json`: demonstration-only, fictional polygon, not source data.
